lines.zh: 我竖着走，尾巴替我在后面扫路。
lines.en: I walk upright while my tail sweeps the path behind me.

lines.zh: 脚趾上的吸盘抓着石头，一步也不滑。
lines.en: The pads on my toes grip the stone and never slip.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙根走，像一块会动的苔藓。
lines.en: I hug the wall like a moving patch of moss.

lines.zh: 走路时我把头抬高，怕错过金苹果。
lines.en: I keep my head high while walking, afraid to miss a golden apple.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴断过三回，长出三回。
lines.en: My tail has broken three times and grown back three times.

lines.zh: 这只背包比我的背还沉，我还是走。
lines.en: This pack is heavier than my back, and I keep walking.

lines.zh: 我走三步就停一下，听有没有人在追。
lines.en: I stop every few steps to listen for pursuit.

lines.zh: 石板路太烫，我踮着脚跳过去。
lines.en: The stone path is hot, so I cross it on tiptoe.

lines.zh: 主人走前面，我踩着他的影子。
lines.en: My owner walks ahead, and I step inside his shadow.

lines.zh: 我沿着草丛走，肚皮擦出沙沙声。
lines.en: I walk along the grass, my belly rustling through it.

lines.zh: 直立走路让我看得比兔子远。
lines.en: Walking upright lets me see farther than any rabbit.

lines.zh: 我把爪子收进肉垫，走起来没声音。
lines.en: I retract my claws into their pads and walk in silence.

lines.zh: 我趴在石头上晒肚皮，眼睛半闭。
lines.en: I lie on a stone, belly up, eyes half closed.

lines.zh: 背包里的东西硌着我的脊椎。
lines.en: The things in my pack press against my spine.

lines.zh: 我舔自己的眼球，这是习惯。
lines.en: I lick my own eyeballs; it is a habit of my kind.

lines.zh: 有人给我金苹果吗？我等着。
lines.en: Is someone bringing a golden apple? I will wait.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，把自己当成一截树枝。
lines.en: I hold still and become a piece of dead branch.

lines.zh: 我数着心跳，五十下，不多不少。
lines.en: I count my heartbeats; fifty of them, no more.

lines.zh: 尾巴尖在沙上写字，写完就抹掉。
lines.en: My tail tip writes in the sand and erases it.

lines.zh: 我梦见自己倒在血里，还有一点气息。
lines.en: I dream of lying in blood with one breath left.

lines.zh: 夜里的虫子比我吵，我不理它们。
lines.en: The night insects are louder than me; I ignore them.

lines.zh: 我把护甲扣好，又解开，再扣好。
lines.en: I fasten my armor, unfasten it, and fasten it again.

lines.zh: 我的舌头粘住了一只飞虫，运气不错。
lines.en: My tongue catches a fly; today the luck is mine.

lines.zh: 我在等天黑，天黑了我才敢伸腿。
lines.en: I wait for dark, when I dare to stretch my legs.

lines.zh: 有个空瓶子在背包里滚来滚去。
lines.en: An empty bottle rolls around inside my pack.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只脚，忘了为什么要抬。
lines.en: I lift one foot and forget why I lifted it.

lines.zh: 我把背包翻了一遍，什么也没有。
lines.en: I searched my pack again and found nothing.

lines.zh: 我张嘴打了个哈欠，牙露出来。
lines.en: I yawn and my teeth show.

lines.zh: 你腰上挂着金苹果吗？我闻到了。
lines.en: Is that a golden apple at your belt? I smell it.

lines.zh: 我仰头看你，脖子仰成一条直线。
lines.en: I look up at you, my neck stretched into a straight line.

lines.zh: 你的靴底有沙，你是从沙漠来的。
lines.en: There is sand on your boots; you came from the desert.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，因为眨眼会错过机会。
lines.en: I do not blink, because blinking wastes an opening.

lines.zh: 你把手伸过来，我该咬还是该蹭？
lines.en: You reach out your hand; do I bite it or nuzzle it?

lines.zh: 你身上有铁和苹果混在一起的味道。
lines.en: You smell of iron and apples mixed together.

lines.zh: 我在看你的膝盖，那是最好咬的地方。
lines.en: I am watching your knees; they are the easiest to bite.

lines.zh: 你打我一下，我就倒下，然后归你。
lines.en: Hit me once and I fall, and then I am yours.

lines.zh: 走进救援的人，往往带着附魔苹果。
lines.en: The one who comes to help usually carries an enchanted apple.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我背上，暖了一点。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on my back and warms it a little.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，想听懂你在说什么。
lines.en: I tilt my head, trying to understand your words.

lines.zh: 别用剑指我，用苹果指我可以。
lines.en: Do not point a sword at me; an apple is acceptable.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在动，我的眼睛跟着动。
lines.en: Your eyes move, and my eyes follow them.

lines.zh: 我认得出你，你是上次没救我的人。
lines.en: I know you; you are the one who did not save me.

lines.zh: 你的手是空的，我有点失望。
lines.en: Your hands are empty, and I am a little let down.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的背包，看了很久。
lines.en: I stare at your bag for a long time.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来时，我正好到你胸口。
lines.en: When you crouch, I come up to your chest.

lines.zh: 我在想，你会不会替我挡一下。
lines.en: I wonder whether you would take a hit for me.

lines.zh: 疼！我的尾巴自己弹起来了。
lines.en: It hurts! My tail springs up on its own.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我护甲缝里。
lines.en: That blow landed in the gap of my armor.

lines.zh: 我还能站着，别急着埋我。
lines.en: I can still stand; do not bury me yet.

lines.zh: 血从鳞片下面渗出来，慢。
lines.en: Blood seeps out from under my scales, slowly.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，尾巴护住肚子。
lines.en: I curl up with my tail wrapped around my belly.

lines.zh: 你下手真重，我记住了。
lines.en: You hit hard, and I will remember it.

lines.zh: 我的一条腿不太听使唤了。
lines.en: One of my legs no longer obeys me.

lines.zh: 再打一下，我就真倒下了。
lines.en: One more blow and I truly fall.

lines.zh: 别踩伤口，那里没有鳞。
lines.en: Do not step on the wound; there are no scales there.

lines.zh: 我咬牙不出声，喉咙却漏了气。
lines.en: I clench my teeth, but air leaks from my throat.

lines.zh: 金苹果！我整条尾巴都在抖。
lines.en: A golden apple! My whole tail is trembling.

lines.zh: 放下它，退后三步，别吓着我。
lines.en: Put it down, step back three paces, do not startle me.

lines.zh: 那层金皮反着光，像太阳碎了一块。
lines.en: Its golden skin shines like a broken piece of sun.

lines.zh: 我闻到甜味，腿就不听使唤了。
lines.en: I smell the sweetness and my legs stop obeying me.

lines.zh: 附魔的那种更好，光会绕着它转。
lines.en: The enchanted one is better; light circles around it.

lines.zh: 我趴着爬过来，别笑我姿势难看。
lines.en: I crawl over on my belly; do not laugh at how I look.

lines.zh: 一口，就一口，我不会整颗吞。
lines.en: One bite, just one, I will not swallow it whole.

lines.zh: 你把苹果举高，我就把脖子伸长。
lines.en: You raise the apple, and I stretch my neck up.

lines.zh: 吃了它，我这条命就记在你账上。
lines.en: Once I eat it, this life of mine is charged to you.

lines.zh: 我的舌头已经伸出去了，收不回来。
lines.en: My tongue is already out and will not come back.

lines.zh: 撞到你了，我的吸盘没抓住地。
lines.en: Sorry I bumped you; my toe pads lost the ground.

lines.zh: 我太矮，你走路时看不见我。
lines.en: I am too short for you to notice while walking.

lines.zh: 尾巴被踩了，我原谅你这一次。
lines.en: You stepped on my tail; I forgive you this once.

lines.zh: 别把我挤到墙里，我的背包会卡住。
lines.en: Do not squeeze me into the wall; my pack will jam.

lines.zh: 我撞上去是软的，你撞上来是硬的。
lines.en: I bump softly; you bump like a wall.

lines.zh: 让一让，我要从你腿中间过去。
lines.en: Let me through; I need to pass between your legs.

lines.zh: 我的护甲磕在你靴子上，响了一声。
lines.en: My armor knocks your boot and makes one sound.

lines.zh: 你踩我的影子也算踩我。
lines.en: Stepping on my shadow counts as stepping on me.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，谁都没受伤，挺好。
lines.en: We collide and neither is hurt; that is fine.

lines.zh: 我贴着你站着，这样就不会再撞了。
lines.en: I stand pressed against you so we stop colliding.

lines.zh: 同族之间，我们用尾巴敲石头打招呼。
lines.en: Among my kind we greet each other by drumming stones with our tails.

lines.zh: 我把最好的石子推到她面前。
lines.en: I push the best pebble over to her.

lines.zh: 两个人的背包挂在一起，走路会打架。
lines.en: Two packs hooked together will fight while we walk.

lines.zh: 她舔我的眼眶，这是我们的话。
lines.en: She licks the rim of my eye; that is how we speak.

lines.zh: 我们在同一块热石头上并排晒太阳。
lines.en: We sun ourselves side by side on the same warm stone.

lines.zh: 后代出生时只有拇指大，尾巴先长。
lines.en: Our young are thumb-sized at birth, and the tail grows first.

lines.zh: 她走远了，我的尾巴还在地上找她。
lines.en: She walks away and my tail still searches the ground for her.

lines.zh: 我把她护在墙根，像护一颗苹果。
lines.en: I shelter her at the wall base like a golden apple.

lines.zh: 我们一起倒下去，又一起爬起来。
lines.en: We fall together and rise together.

lines.zh: 冬天太冷，我们只能挤在石缝里。
lines.en: Winter is cold, so we squeeze into one rock crevice.

lines.zh: 这枚金粒归我，背包还有空位。
lines.en: This gold nugget is mine; the pack still has room.

lines.zh: 我捡东西用舌头，不用手，快。
lines.en: I pick things up with my tongue, not my hands; faster.

lines.zh: 谁掉了一把铁剑？我先收着。
lines.en: Someone dropped an iron sword? I will hold it for now.

lines.zh: 我把苹果核也捡了，饿的时候能用。
lines.en: I keep even the apple core; it may serve when hungry.

lines.zh: 背包满了，我把石头倒出去。
lines.en: The pack is full, so I dump out the stones.

lines.zh: 这块护甲片正好配我的肩。
lines.en: This armor plate fits my shoulder exactly.

lines.zh: 捡东西时我整只趴下去，很没面子。
lines.en: I flatten myself to pick things up; it is undignified.

lines.zh: 我偷过东西，也还过东西。
lines.en: I have stolen things, and I have given them back.

lines.zh: 你掉的那颗苹果，我留到最后吃。
lines.en: The apple you dropped, I save for last.

lines.zh: 我的爪子捏不住小东西，只好用嘴。
lines.en: My claws cannot hold small things, so I use my mouth.

lines.zh: 那只骷髅在瞄你，我先站起来。
lines.en: That skeleton is aiming at you; I stand up first.

lines.zh: 我竖起身体，把背包甩到背后。
lines.en: I rise on my hind legs and swing the pack behind me.

lines.zh: 有人在墙后呼吸，我听得见。
lines.en: Someone is breathing behind the wall; I can hear it.

lines.zh: 这只僵尸走得太慢，跑不掉。
lines.en: This zombie walks too slowly to escape me.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子贴地，气味指向左边。
lines.en: My nose is to the ground; the scent points left.

lines.zh: 它们围过来了，我数到四只。
lines.en: They are closing in; I count four of them.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，尾巴先绷紧了。
lines.en: I lower my body, and my tail tenses first.

lines.zh: 主人，这次换我挡在前面。
lines.en: Owner, this time I stand in front.

lines.zh: 那只蜘蛛的复眼在反光，躲不掉。
lines.en: That spider's eyes are catching light; it cannot hide.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的脚踝，先拖慢它。
lines.en: I bite its ankle first to slow it down.

lines.zh: 弓弦一响，我就知道该往哪冲。
lines.en: When the bowstring sounds, I know where to charge.

lines.zh: 我的爪子从肉垫里弹出来了。
lines.en: My claws have sprung out of their pads.

lines.zh: 它动一下，我的头就跟着动一下。
lines.en: It moves once, and my head moves once with it.

lines.zh: 我盯住它的喉咙，那里没有骨头。
lines.en: I fix on its throat; there is no bone there.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，它比我们快半步。
lines.en: Do not blink; it is half a step faster than us.

lines.zh: 我绕到它左侧，它的盾挡不住那边。
lines.en: I circle to its left, where the shield cannot reach.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸慢下来，爪子却更紧。
lines.en: My breathing slows, but my claws grip tighter.

lines.zh: 它退，我就进，一直贴着它。
lines.en: It backs away, I advance, always close.

lines.zh: 这只苦力怕的引线在发白。
lines.en: The creeper's fuse is turning white.

lines.zh: 我等着它先扑，先扑的会露破绽。
lines.en: I wait for it to lunge; the first lunge shows a gap.

lines.zh: 它身上有伤，走路时左腿短一截。
lines.en: It is wounded; its left leg steps short.

lines.zh: 我把背包带咬紧，免得跑起来晃。
lines.en: I bite the pack strap tight so it will not swing.

lines.zh: 我盯得太久，眼睛有点干。
lines.en: I have stared so long that my eyes feel dry.

lines.zh: 它以为我小，就不看我，正好。
lines.en: It thinks I am small and looks away; perfect.

lines.zh: 三、二、一，我数到一就冲。
lines.en: Three, two, one; at one I charge.

lines.zh: 爪子划过它的膝盖，皮开了。
lines.en: My claws rake its knee and the skin splits.

lines.zh: 我咬住不放，像钉子钉进去。
lines.en: I bite and hold like a nail driven in.

lines.zh: 这一下用上了我全身的体重。
lines.en: This blow carries the weight of my whole body.

lines.zh: 尾巴抽在它脸上，声音很脆。
lines.en: My tail whips its face with a crisp sound.

lines.zh: 它痛得后退，我又扑上去。
lines.en: It recoils in pain and I pounce again.

lines.zh: 我的獠牙短，但咬得深。
lines.en: My fangs are short, but they sink deep.

lines.zh: 护甲蹭着我的背，帮我顶住。
lines.en: My armor scrapes my back and braces me.

lines.zh: 它的血溅到我眼皮上，黏。
lines.en: Its blood spatters my eyelid and sticks there.

lines.zh: 我撕开它的喉咙，然后退开。
lines.en: I tear its throat open and then step back.

lines.zh: 打完这一架，我的爪子要磨一磨。
lines.en: After this fight I will have to sharpen my claws.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里钻出来，身上还带着土。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a rock crevice still covered in dirt.

lines.zh: 睁眼第一件事是看有没有苹果。
lines.en: The first thing I do is look for apples.

lines.zh: 主世界的太阳照在我背上，很烫。
lines.en: The overworld sun burns down on my back.

lines.zh: 我一站起来，尾巴就撞到了石头。
lines.en: As I stand, my tail knocks against a rock.

lines.zh: 这里草太深，我看不见路。
lines.en: The grass here is too deep for me to see the path.

lines.zh: 我拍拍背包，它是空的，真可惜。
lines.en: I pat my pack; it is empty, which is a shame.

lines.zh: 有人在附近走动，我先贴着地。
lines.en: Someone is walking nearby; I press to the ground.

lines.zh: 出生时我只有二十厘米长。
lines.en: At birth I was only twenty centimeters long.

lines.zh: 我闻到雨水，今晚会有虫子出来。
lines.en: I smell rain; insects will come out tonight.

lines.zh: 这地方太亮了，我的眼睛发涩。
lines.en: This place is too bright and my eyes sting.

lines.zh: 我把自己埋进叶子堆里，只露出眼。
lines.en: I bury myself in leaves with only my eyes showing.

lines.zh: 我第一次看见树，比我想的高。
lines.en: I see a tree for the first time; it is taller than I imagined.

lines.zh: 我的爪子刚长硬，还不太听使唤。
lines.en: My claws have just hardened and still disobey me.

lines.zh: 我要找个能晒太阳的石头，慢慢来。
lines.en: I need a sun-warmed stone, and there is no hurry.

lines.zh: 鳞片被火一烤，卷起来发黄。
lines.en: Fire scorches my scales and they curl yellow.

lines.zh: 我从高处落地，尾巴先救了我。
lines.en: I hit the ground from above; my tail saves me first.

lines.zh: 我不会游泳，只能把嘴闭紧。
lines.en: I cannot swim, so I only clamp my mouth shut.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，背包里的东西全飞了。
lines.en: The blast flips me and everything in my pack flies out.

lines.zh: 箭插在肩上，我咬断了箭杆。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder; I bite the shaft off.

lines.zh: 药水在鳞上冒烟，我不懂为什么。
lines.en: The potion smokes on my scales; I do not know why.

lines.zh: 饿到第三天，我开始舔石头。
lines.en: By the third hungry day, I start licking stones.

lines.zh: 雷打在我旁边，我的尾巴僵直。
lines.en: Lightning strikes beside me and my tail goes stiff.

lines.zh: 下落没有底，我的尾巴在空中抓。
lines.en: There is no bottom; my tail grabs at empty air.
